plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the parent's fixed-environment shortcut: the current target law maps instantaneous velocity to a unique acceleration, with one shared quadratic curvature set by drag_coefficient/mass. plan.activation_condition: Most visible when the particle undergoes sustained motion long enough to build a disturbed co-moving wake over a timescale comparable to wake_relaxation_time or regime_relaxation_time, and when |v| is large enough that drag is dynamically important relative to g; negligible in very short transients or near-rest motion.
plan.train_hidden_contrast: In training, long downward runs already create wake-memory effects through wake_drag and regime_occupancy but the target still depends only on absolute speed; extending to holdout with stronger speed reversals or abrupt release conditions reveals additional acceleration differences caused by slip-relative drag that are not reproducible by the parent with one shared parameter set.
plan.continuation_path: Recover the parent law in the limit of vanishing or instantaneously relaxing local-flow advection memory, so the medium is effectively stationary and drag depends only on v.
plan.promotion_reason: A stationary-medium model cannot represent history-dependent slip between the particle and a locally entrained disturbed flow. This requires one dynamic state for the local co-flow velocity; existing states only scale drag magnitude and regime occupancy and cannot encode signed medium motion relative to the particle.
plan.gap_statement: The current model assumes the surrounding medium is stationary even while it already includes finite wake development; this omits the possibility that the disturbed flow acquires a transient co-moving velocity that changes drag through slip speed rather than particle speed alone.
plan.baseline_assumption: The medium is uniform and stationary.
plan.scientific_mechanism: Wake entrainment or local co-flow memory: after sustained motion, the nearby fluid is partially carried with the particle and relaxes back over finite time, so the resistive force remains direction-opposing to the slip velocity but no longer depends only on the particle's absolute velocity.
plan.rationale: A realistic next refinement is to relax the stationary-medium assumption rather than adding a wholly new force. The parent target mapping is effectively a fixed-environment law: once wake_drag and regime_occupancy are observed, dv_dt is an even-in-speed drag correction plus constant gravity, with no dependence on whether the surrounding disturbed fluid is co-moving. Hold mass, g, drag_coefficient, critical_speed, drag_reduction_fraction, drag_shape_fraction, and the initial conditions fixed; vary the recent velocity history so that one trajectory reaches a given negative v after a long uninterrupted fall while another reaches the same v after a reversal or shorter descent. Under admissible conditions with significant drag and finite wake-memory timescales, the child predicts different accelerations at the same v because the slip relative to the entrained local flow differs. A single refit of the parent parameters cannot reproduce this across both conditions, because its scored mapping at a supplied state is still only a function of v, wake_drag, and regime_occupancy and remains symmetric with respect to medium motion. The refinement is scientifically limited if the disturbed fluid velocity relaxes much faster than the trajectory changes or remains negligible throughout the sampled speeds; in that case the parent is recovered.

response_change.parent_relation: The drag multiplier depends only on the particle speed and internal wake/regime states, so the acceleration-speed curve is symmetric with respect to the medium and is fully determined by v once wake_drag and regime_occupancy are known.
response_change.child_relation: Release the assumption of a stationary medium by allowing the drag to depend on slip speed relative to a slowly evolving local flow state, so the target acceleration depends on the interaction between particle velocity and that flow state rather than on v alone.
response_change.observable_effect: For trajectories with the same instantaneous particle speed v but different recently induced co-flow state, the child predicts weaker downward drag after sustained downward motion and stronger drag after upward motion into still-descending disturbed fluid; the parent cannot produce this history-dependent asymmetry from v alone.

contract.activation_condition: Most visible when the particle undergoes sustained motion long enough to build a disturbed co-moving wake over a timescale comparable to wake_relaxation_time or regime_relaxation_time, and when |v| is large enough that drag is dynamically important relative to g; negligible in very short transients or near-rest motion.
contract.train_hidden_contrast: In training, long downward runs already create wake-memory effects through wake_drag and regime_occupancy but the target still depends only on absolute speed; extending to holdout with stronger speed reversals or abrupt release conditions reveals additional acceleration differences caused by slip-relative drag that are not reproducible by the parent with one shared parameter set.
contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent law in the limit of vanishing or instantaneously relaxing local-flow advection memory, so the medium is effectively stationary and drag depends only on v.
contract.promotion_reason: A stationary-medium model cannot represent history-dependent slip between the particle and a locally entrained disturbed flow. This requires one dynamic state for the local co-flow velocity; existing states only scale drag magnitude and regime occupancy and cannot encode signed medium motion relative to the particle.
contract.domain_mechanism: local wake entrainment modifies drag through slip-relative motion
contract.scientific_mechanism: Wake entrainment or local co-flow memory: after sustained motion, the nearby fluid is partially carried with the particle and relaxes back over finite time, so the resistive force remains direction-opposing to the slip velocity but no longer depends only on the particle's absolute velocity.
contract.difficulty_rationale: This is harder than a coefficient-only correction because the new state changes the argument of the nonlinear drag law itself, creating trajectory-dependent acceleration differences at the same instantaneous particle speed. Retuning existing drag gains can only rescale or reshape a v-only resistance curve, not create a slip-mediated interaction with signed local flow memory.
contract.assumption_before: The medium is uniform and stationary.
contract.assumption_after: The nearby medium can acquire a transient entrained co-flow velocity that relaxes back to the ambient state, so drag depends on slip relative to that local flow.
contract.before_fragment: -g - (wake_drag * regime_occupancy / mass) * v * Abs(v) * (1 + drag_shape_fraction * Abs(v) / (critical_speed + Abs(v)))
contract.after_fragment: -g - (wake_drag * regime_occupancy / mass) * (v - local_flow_velocity) * Abs(v - local_flow_velocity) * (1 + drag_shape_fraction * Abs(v - local_flow_velocity) / (critical_speed + Abs(v - local_flow_velocity)))
contract.parent_reduction: The successor reduces to the parent when entrainment_fraction = 0 or flow_relaxation_time -> 0, giving local_flow_velocity -> 0 so drag depends only on v.
contract.observable_signature: Hold fixed mass, g, drag_coefficient, critical_speed, drag_reduction_fraction, drag_shape_fraction, and the initial conditions; compare times at which two trajectories share the same instantaneous v, wake_drag, and regime_occupancy but differ in local_flow_velocity because one follows a long same-direction fall and the other follows a reversal. The child then gives different dv_dt through slip-relative drag, with reduced resistance when local_flow_velocity has been entrained toward v and enhanced resistance when it opposes v; this effect is observable when flow memory persists over the sampled trajectory segment.
contract.shortcut_blocked: A single parent parameter set cannot reproduce this contrast because its scored target mapping is exactly a function of v, wake_drag, and regime_occupancy only, with no argument for signed medium motion. Refitting wake or regime timescales can change auxiliary trajectories, but once those supplied states are fixed the parent assigns one unique dv_dt, whereas the child assigns different dv_dt values at the same supplied parent-state coordinates when local_flow_velocity differs.

range_suggestions.local_flow_velocity: order of the particle speed magnitude, with admissible sign matching recent motion
range_suggestions.flow_relaxation_time: positive and comparable to or larger than short wake-memory timescales when co-flow memory is observable
